title: Abaphuli Besivumelwano Abadingisiwe
intro: Ezinsukwini zokuqala zomphakathi omusha, isizwe sasihlala ezindlini eziqinile, siboshwe yisivumelwano. Lapho leso sivumelwano sidalulwa, imiphumela yazwakala emakhasini e-Quran. Babengobani laba bantu, futhi kwenzekani ngemizi yabo nezithelo zabo?
clues: Sasihlala ezinqabeni ezazisinika umuzwa wokulondeka ongamanga.
Sasingabantu bomBhalo, kodwa sephula isivumelwano sethu.
Saceba ngokumelene nesithunywa ngemva kokuba sifikile kithi, kodwa icebo lethu lahluleka.
Izihlahla zethu zesundu zanqunywa ngomyalo ka-Allah, uphawu lwamandla aKhe.
Saxoshwa emakhaya ethu, asisaphinde sibuye, njengesijeziso sokungalaleli kwethu.
I-Quran ikhuluma ngathi esahlukweni somhlangano, futhi indaba yethu isebenza njengesixwayiso kulabo abaphula izivumelwano.
arabic: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verse: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient. (59:5)
